component.name: PrintEase
component.summary: Find and use printers and scanners instantly — driverless, zero config

description.p: PrintEase is a modern, desktop-agnostic printer and scanner management app for Linux — a contemporary replacement for system-config-printer. It discovers network printers and scanners automatically via mDNS/DNS-SD and speaks the open, driverless standards: IPP Everywhere for printing and eSCL (AirScan) for scanning. No manufacturer drivers, no plug-ins, no configuration.

ul.li: Automatic network discovery of IPP printers and eSCL scanners (built-in mDNS — works with or without a running Avahi daemon)
Honest capability display: shows exactly what the device reports via its PPD
Default settings management: paper size, duplex, color mode, quality
Driverless scanning via eSCL/AirScan — flatbed and document feeder, single and multi-page
Printer actions: set default, pause/resume, test page

description.p: Printing and printer management use the host CUPS service. Network features (discovery, eSCL scanning) require network access; USB printers configured in CUPS work regardless.
Maintenance release: the Flatpak now uses the current GNOME 51 runtime, the test suite runs without network access, and the license of the metadata file is declared correctly in the Debian package.

Built-in mDNS discovery fallback (python-zeroconf): network printer and scanner (eSCL) discovery as well as .local host name resolution now work without a running Avahi daemon — including inside the Flatpak sandbox. More reliable discovery results. First Flatpak release.
